All revenues from the lands set aside under preceding section shall accrue to the Tarlac College
of Agriculture; Provided, however, That the utilization of any existing timber and/or other forest products
therein shall be subject to forestry laws, rules and regulations.

All laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations which are inconsistent herewith are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
